title: Belum Tempah Grab
mood: falling for someone and stalling on purpose
subject: a first date at a café that runs to closing time because the rain gives you both an excuse
caption: Malay jazz-pop in the Sheila Majid lineage, a light mid-tempo smooth jazz-pop groove. A Rhodes electric piano comping with ninth, eleventh and thirteenth voicings over ii-V-I changes, a fretless electric bass sliding between roots with short melodic fills, a live drum kit played light with sidestick on the snare, a soft ride cymbal and ghost notes, a soprano saxophone answering the vocal and taking a short solo before the last chorus, and a clean chorused jazz guitar comping in short chords. Warm and close, a polished late-80s studio sound with soft plate reverb, Rhodes and voice forward, the sax slightly back. Smooth female alto phrased slightly behind the beat, clean diction, no belting, a few light scat ad-libs. 96 BPM, F major. Falling for someone and stalling on purpose. No bossa nova, no funk horn section, no slap bass, no programmed R&B beats, no power-ballad chorus, no autotune, no trap, no big string build.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and sidestick]

[Verse 1]
Kopi kedua dah sejuk, kek pandan tinggal separuh
Hujan kat luar cermin turun macam tak nak berhenti
Awak cerita pasal kucing jiran yang selalu tidur dalam kasut awak
Aku ketawa kuat sangat, orang meja sebelah toleh

[Pre-Chorus]
Telefon aku dalam beg, bateri tujuh puluh peratus
Aku tak keluarkan pun

[Chorus]
Aku belum tempah Grab
Hujan ni alasan paling elok aku pernah dapat
Kalau awak tanya, aku cakap surge mahal sangat
Padahal aku cuma nak dengar awak habiskan cerita

[Verse 2]
Pelayan dah susun kerusi atas meja hujung
Awak minta satu lagi teh tarik, "kurang manis, terima kasih"
Payung awak kecil, payung aku tertinggal kat pejabat
Kalau kongsi pun, kena jalan rapat sikit lah

[Bridge - soprano sax solo, then the voice returns]
Pukul sepuluh, separuh lampu kafe dah tutup
Awak pun belum sentuh telefon awak

[Chorus]
Aku belum tempah Grab
Hujan dah berhenti sepuluh minit tadi, kita buat-buat tak nampak
Kalau awak tanya, aku cakap surge mahal sangat
Padahal aku cuma nak dengar awak habiskan cerita

[Outro - Rhodes alone, light scat]
Jalan kaki je lah
Stesen LRT tak jauh, kan?
